messages:
anya: Quick cross-team readout — where are we on model-catalog launch gating? Need explicit owners for licensing checks, perf profiles, canary schedule. TL;DR: catalog UI freeze Fri EOD. Please reply with short status + blockers. @devin @sarah_chen @matt_p @liz

 devin: Perf profiling done for mariner-7b and orchid13b. Missing perf for ozark-3b and fenrir-6b. I'll run benchmark for ozark today, but need the quantized checkpoint path from eng-releases. cc @matt_p

 matt_p: Legal review blocking mosaic7b (license ambiguity). Filed ticket LR-2026-42. Can set mosaic7b as 'preview' if we get interim approval. Also need model-card fields filled: train_data, eval_sets.

 sarah_chen: Licensing: Legal asked for third-party tokenizers list and model weights provenance for mosaic7b. @legal_bot did you get the S3 manifest?

 legal_bot: Automated: LR ticket LR-2026-42 created. Assigned to @jordan. Deadline request: 48h. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/LR-2026-42

 jordan: On it, have asked infra for manifest and provenance; expecting reply by EOD. If not available we'll mark mosaic7b as preview.

 chris: For perf runs use: `./bench/run_perf.sh --model ozark-3b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --quant true` CI job is `ci/bench-ozark`. I pushed a small harness change in PR #2387.

 liz: I'll own embeddings integration tests for the catalog. Planning to add smoke test with `curl` to the hosted API and a unit test for cached prefixes. ETA Wed.

 anya: Great. Action items: Devin -> perf for ozark (today), Chris -> confirm CI job + merge PR2387, Liz -> embeddings tests (Wed), Jordan -> legal for mosaic7b (48h), Matt -> model-card fields for mosaic7b. I'll schedule a 15m sync Thu 09:30 PT if still unmet. Reply with :thumbsup: when done.

 devin: Running ozark perf now, will post results in this thread. ETA 2h.

 matt_p: Started filling model-card. Missing 'eval_sets' — Pete from ML infra said he'll export subset. @pete any eta?

 pete: exporting eval subsets now, should be ready in ~3 hours. posting s3 link when done.

 anya: Thanks all — if anyone needs a hand ping me or drop blockers here. We'll use this thread as canonical until launch. :rocket:
